@deskInvSetTitle.description: Settings › Receiving section title: the invoice address and who may bill you.

deskInvSetIntro: Services you trust bill this wallet at its invoice address. Nothing is paid until you approve each invoice.

@deskInvSetIntro.description: Intro of the Invoices settings section.

@deskInvSetAddressLabel.description: Label of this wallet's separate address for receiving invoices.

deskInvSetAddressWarning: Give it only to services you trust. It does not receive payments.

@deskInvSetAddressWarning.description: Warning beside the invoice address and its QR code: never use it to receive money.

deskInvSetCopied: Invoice address copied. Give it only to services you trust; it does not receive payments.

@deskInvSetCopied.description: Notice after copying the invoice address, repeating the warning.

@deskInvSetQrShow.description: Button: show the invoice address as a QR code.

deskInvSetQrLabel: QR code of your invoice address

@deskInvSetQrLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the invoice address QR code.

@deskInvSetIndex.description: Which invoice address this is (it changes when rotated), e.g. 'Invoice address 2'.

@deskInvSetTrusted.description: List title: services and contacts allowed to send you invoices.

deskInvSetTrustedNone: No trusted senders. Invoices from anyone else are ignored unread.

@deskInvSetContactTag.description: Tag on a trusted sender that is one of your contacts.

deskInvSetRemoveBody: {name} can no longer send you invoices. Invoices already waiting stay until you answer them or they expire.
deskInvSetRemoved: {name} can no longer send you invoices.

@deskInvSetRemoved.description: Notice after removing a trusted sender.

@deskInvSetKeep.description: Dialog button: keep as it is.

@deskInvSetAdd.description: Button: add a service allowed to send you invoices.

deskInvSetAddBody: A trusted sender can bill this wallet at its invoice address. Nothing is paid until you approve each invoice with your wallet password.

@deskInvSetAddBody.description: Text of the Trust a sender dialog.

@deskInvSetName.description: Field label: your name for the sender, shown on its invoices.

@deskInvSetSenderAddress.description: Field label: the Epicbox address the service shows on its site.

deskInvSetSenderMissing: Paste the address the service shows.
deskInvSetSenderInvalid: This is not a valid Epicbox address.

@deskInvSetTrust.description: Dialog button: add the sender to the trusted list.

@deskInvSetDropped.description: Quiet line: messages to the invoice address from untrusted senders, dropped without opening.

@deskInvSetRotate.description: Button (Advanced): move to a fresh invoice address.

deskInvSetRotateHint: Services that have the old one can no longer send you invoices.
deskInvSetRotateBody: Services that have the old one can no longer send you invoices. Give the new one to every service that bills you.

@deskInvSetRotateConfirm.description: Dialog button: rotate the invoice address.

deskInvSetRotated: New invoice address ready. Give it to your services.

@deskInvSetExpiry.description: Setting (Advanced): how long requests and invoices stay payable.

deskInvSetExpiryHint: How long an invoice you issue stays payable, and how long one you receive waits for you. At most 48 hours.

@deskInvSetExpiryHint.description: Text of the Time to pay setting.

@deskInvSetHours.description: A duration in hours, e.g. '24 hours'.

@deskInvSetContactSection.description: Section title in a contact's detail: their invoice address and trust.

@deskInvSetTheirInvoice.description: Contact field: where requests to this contact go.

deskInvSetTheirInvoiceNone: No invoice address saved. Ask them for it to issue invoices to them.

@deskInvSetTheirInvoiceNone.description: Contact detail when no invoice address is saved.

@deskInvSetTrustedSwitch.description: Contact switch: this contact may send you invoices.

deskInvSetTrustedSwitchHelp: Lets this contact bill you. Nothing is paid until you approve an invoice.

@deskInvSetIssueNeeds.description: Why Request payment is disabled for a contact.

@deskInvSetShare.description: Contact action: copy your invoice address to give to this contact.

deskInvSetReceiveHint: Ask a contact or a service to pay you. Their wallet must take invoices.

@deskInvSetReceiveHint.description: Text beside Request a payment on Receive.

deskInvSetRestoredHint: Restored this wallet from its recovery phrase? Give services this invoice address again.

@deskInvSetRestoredHint.description: Line under the invoice address while its index is 1: a wallet restored without its history file starts again at the first invoice address, so services hold an old one (flow.md §2, P-16).
